info.description: ChargeAssist Management Api. All endpoints require a Authorization header.

requestBody.description: expects AdId, Domain and list of DriverIds

put.description:
Create and register this app token to the backend.
The appToken identifies a unique User or Driver. Other objects such as Payments, Favorites and Sessions will be linked to this appToken.
It can be linked to a unique identifier for Charge Assist User, a Driver ID in the GreenFlux CRM system or a SSO solution provided by the eMSP / app integration.

parameters.name: appToken
parameters.description: unique identifier for Charge Assist User

This endpoint allows you to add a new payment method for external payment service providers (PSPs).
Please be aware that you are responsible for ensuring the proper processing of these payments as well as that the provided external
payment method ID is valid and corresponds to a payment method.

put.summary: Store a new charge card in this user's wallet
put.description:
Store a new charge card in the user's digital wallet for EV charging payments. 
This endpoint allows you to register physical charge cards or RFID tokens that users can use to 
authenticate and pay for charging sessions at compatible charging stations. Only the `visualNumber` 
field is required and the `displayName` field is optional. The remaining properties should not be provided unless 
this was intentionally activated as a feature.

FailedSessionPaymentModelListResponse.description:
Generic container for all list models.
            
As returning a json array from a GET is a security risk (http://haacked.com/archive/2008/11/20/anatomy-of-a-subtle-json-vulnerability.aspx/) we wrap it in a container object.
            
Also: this contains optional metadata useful for pagination of results.

LocationEvseAvailability.description: Availability details of a Location and it's EVSEs.

reservationEnabled.description: is reservation enabled, value is always false.

pms.description: List of supported payment methods. Empty list means: no restrictions (all accepted).

issuers.description: List of supported chard card issuers. Empty list means: no restrictions (all accepted).

preAuthAmountInCents.description: Amount to be reserved while starting a charge session

Generic container for all list models.
            
As returning a json array from a GET is a security risk (http://haacked.com/archive/2008/11/20/anatomy-of-a-subtle-json-vulnerability.aspx/) we wrap it in a container object.
            
Also: this contains optional metadata useful for pagination of results.

dCount.description: Count in string format. count > 99 Then '99+' Else count

locationIds.description: The location ids are provided when it is a single location or multiple locations have exact same coordinates

continuationToken.description: continuation token for the next page request

primaryColorHex.description: Hex color code to be used within the scope of a Location. Color code is prefixed with '#'. E.g. '#12aaf4'

id.description: unique id of the payment method

externalPaymentMethodId.description: id of the external payment method id. when the user handles the payment transactions themselves and this is a refernce passed to us.

isCompatible.description: checks if payment method compatible for a location

isVidMapped.description: is vid mapped to the payment method. (used for autocharge)

driverName.description: name of the charge card driver

displayName.description: is name of the payment method

preferredNetwork.description: is name of preferred network type

PaymentMethodModelListResponse.description:
Generic container for all list models.
            
As returning a json array from a GET is a security risk (http://haacked.com/archive/2008/11/20/anatomy-of-a-subtle-json-vulnerability.aspx/) we wrap it in a container object.
            
Also: this contains optional metadata useful for pagination of results.

visualNumber.description: visual number of the charge card

chipId.description: chip id of the charge card

activate.description: activate the token if charge card token is not activated yet

displayName.description: name of the external payment method.

pspPaymentMethodId.description: external payment method reference id. This should be the unique external payment methodId of the user

customerOrWalletId.description: This is the customer or walletId which the pspPaymentMethodId belongs to.

cardAlias.description: Optional card alias / nick name to remember this card more easily

cardNumberHint.description: Last 4-digits of the credit card, e.g. '4242'

weekday.description: Number of day in the week, from Monday (1) till Sunday (7)

vidStatus.description: status of vid mapping (for auto charge feature)

SessionHistoryV2ModelListResponse.description:
Generic container for all list models.
            
As returning a json array from a GET is a security risk (http://haacked.com/archive/2008/11/20/anatomy-of-a-subtle-json-vulnerability.aspx/) we wrap it in a container object.
            
Also: this contains optional metadata useful for pagination of results.

displayName.description: is name of the payment method

isPinned.description: the flag to set if its the main session (used mainly for our internal apps).

ignoreEvseAvailablity.description: the flag to set for ignoring the evse status and still try to remote start a session

nextStatusCall.description: next session status request proposed after

externalSessionId.description: external sessionId. The field is available when the session is started.

error.description: error code. When there is an error in Start/Stop operation

errorMessage.description: error message. When there is an error in Start/Stop operation

energyInKwh.description: total energy in kwh. Available when data points are received from the charge station during the session

currentPowerInKw.description: current power in kw. Available when data points are received from the charge station during the session

totalCosts.description: total costs. Available when the session status is cdr_available

totalVat.description: total vat applied. Available when the session status is cdr_available

vatPercentage.description: vat percentage applied. Available when the session status is cdr_available

startTime.description: session start time in location timezone. Available after the session is successfully started

endTime.description: session end time in location time zone. Available after the session is successfully stopped

nextStatusCall.description: the next suggested time to call this endpoint to get the session status

smartChargingEnabled.description: is smart charging enabled. Available after the session is successfully started and for internal GFX locations

vidStatus.description: status of vid mapping (for auto charge feature)

stateOfCharge.description: state of charge. Available after the session is successfully started

receiptNumber.description: receipt unique identifier. Generated after the session is completed. Available after the session status is cdr_available and direct payment is successful.

couponStatus.description: status of coupon (if coupon is applied)

mileage.description: Updated Mileage by the user after the session is started.

validFrom.description: Local date and time without a timezone or UTC offset.

validTo.description: Local date and time without a timezone or UTC offset.

appToken.description: unique identifier for Charge Assist User

authId.description: unique auth id of the token

groups.description: List with names of the groups this user is member of (display names)

groupFilterString.description: String to pass to location calls to include closed groups this user has access to. Just pass this string as-is to the 'filter.groupIds' parameter.

vidUpdating.description: is vid mapping updating (for auto charge)

muteVidNotifications.description: mute auto charge push notifications //only applicable for internal app.

personalChargerSettings.description: User settings for their personal charger e.g. do not charge between 17PM and 20PM
